name: zones_t15_get_random_lot
description: Conformance test 15 (GetRandomLot, §9 Z1). Generator lcg := 1, one 1 × 1 lot at (47, 37) (token 0x1000, the first the world hands out). GetRandomLot draws U(cellsX) then U(cellsZ) per try: try 1 = (0, 22) (no lot), try 2 = (47, 37) (the lot) -> returns that lot after 4 draws.
